notes: NEW: Learning Profile — optional study supports in the Study tab, all off by default and kept on this device only: small steps (one quiz question and one summary point at a time, with a “Got it — next step” check), read-aloud Listen buttons (quiz, flashcards, summary, using your device’s built-in speech), extra time (1.5×) and untimed practice for Exam Rounds, plain language + highlights presentation, vocabulary pre-teach from your own material, encouragement in quiz feedback, a graphic organizer, and settings import/export.

Nothing else changed: the detector (V20), study packs, tutor rules, and Ollama connection are untouched. This release brings the Learning Profile to the v2.36.0 build, including the Computer Science Basics pack.
